title: Citation share dropping — 14 comparison queries cite competitors only

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

checks.label: No auto-publish
checks.note: Every approved page routes through an editor before it goes live.

checks.label: Canonical URL structure
checks.note: New pages sit under /guides/{topic}. Consolidation uses 301s, not new path patterns.

checks.label: Consolidate before publishing
checks.note: Cannibalisation pairs resolve before the new comparison page ships.

checks.label: Brand voice review
checks.note: Every draft carries the voice checklist. A page that reads like keyword filler is rejected at review, not published and measured.

proposal.recommendation: Fix the template, consolidate, then write one definitive page
proposal.recommendation_detail: Two technical repairs the content depends on, three pages that carry the comparative tier, and schema on the guides we already have.

recommendation_metrics.label: Citation share
recommendation_metrics.note: blended across the three intent tiers

items.name: Fix guide-template LCP
items.detail: Hero images on the guide template are unsized and unpreloaded, putting p75 LCP at 2.9s against a 2.5s threshold. Every content gain rides on this one.

items.name: Resolve 9 redirect chains and 4 duplicate canonicals
items.detail: Three chains are three hops deep and sit on guide URLs. The duplicate canonicals are why four pages are not indexed.

items.name: Surface 8 discovered-not-crawled guides
items.detail: Eight guides are known and never fetched because nothing links to them. Sitemap entry plus two internal links each.

items.name: Consolidate 3 cannibalisation pairs
items.detail: Redirect the weaker page of each pair into the stronger one and set canonicals. Without this the new comparison page competes with our own thin pages.

item_groups.label: Content briefs · drafted by Realify, published by an editor

items.name: Definitive comparison page · carbon steel vs cast iron
items.detail: Nine-row comparison table, weight and heat-retention figures with published sources, answer-first headings. Projected entry into 9 of the 14 competitor-only citations.
items.routeNote: Realify drafts the full page; an editor reviews, edits and publishes it.

items.name: Rewrite lead-removal page with the certification stated
items.detail: The certification number is in a PDF nobody links to. Stating it in text, with a reduction percentage per contaminant, is what the cited answers all have.
items.routeNote: Realify drafts the full page; an editor reviews, edits and publishes it.

items.name: Cooktop compatibility explainer with material table
items.detail: Replaces a hedged paragraph with a material-by-material table and a stated test method. Also fixes the listing-outranks-explainer problem.
items.routeNote: Realify drafts the full page; an editor reviews, edits and publishes it.

items.name: Price-bounded recommendation page · pans under $120
items.detail: A new page for a query with nothing behind it. Named recommendation and price in the opening, Product schema linking to the SKU.
items.routeNote: Realify writes the brief and the outline; a writer produces the copy.

items.name: FAQ and Article schema on 40 guide pages
items.detail: Generated from existing headings and body content, not written separately. Raises the structured-formatting score on every page it touches.

items.name: Product schema on recommendation blocks
items.detail: Links every named recommendation in a guide to its SKU, price and availability so the transactional tier has something to cite.

slate.name: lead-removal page with the certification stated
